comment: hpft-shaper v2 lab registry. v3 adds scheme-E fields: per-vnic MAC, policy (design_e §3.1), e_params (design_e §5.4 initial values, tuned in M4). rdma_rules kept for the legacy static-cap controller path. Units: rate_bps absolute; PCC converts to 2^20-of-linerate units (line = 200 Gb/s).

rdma_flowtags.comment: per-(src,dst) PCC flowtags, probed via 0xdea 2026-07-11. The tag hashes (src function, dst function) and is stable across QP recreation, IP choice and reflash. KNOWN COLLISION: src vf1 and src vf2 produce identical tags for every dst (rows below are equal), so vf1->X and vf2->X RDMA budgets are inseparable at the RP - never schedule both concurrently. tx_agent_e keys RDMA budgets by 'src>dst' with fallback to the per-vnic flowtag.

policy.comment: design_e §3.1. VM == vnic in this lab. weight = W_i (inter-tenant); max_rate_bps = MaxRate_i (null = uncapped); class_weights = W_{i,TCP}/W_{i,RDMA}. per_sender_weights: 'dst_vnic|class|src_vnic' -> u (absent = 1). Receiver scheduler reads dst-VM params; sender tree reads src-VM params.

control.comment: Scheme-E control plane addressing. telemetry: host -> its DPU's in-band ctl IP (PF1 SF on underlay-p1, rides the p1/switch data path per design_e §3.4 user note). pace_shim: sender host -> shim addr as reachable from that host's DPU (tmfifo). tree_stub_bps = static Tree_f until M5's sender tree. rate_export: receiver host -> its DPU rx_agent (tmfifo), fresh kernel-path byte counter for class attribution (2026-07-11).

e_params.comment: design_e 5.4 + 1ms retrofit. RESPONSE LAW = MIMD (2026-07-13): multiplicative increase hard-capped at the fair-share ceiling e_hat (R*=(1+mi_alpha) up to e_hat when s=0), multiplicative mark-proportional decrease (R*=(1-beta*s)^a_scale when s>0). Both directions period-scale by period/ref; the hard cap at e_hat gives structural collapse-immunity (R never sits above the ceiling, so AIMD's overshoot->mark-storm->deep-cut relaxation cannot arise) and no parameter cliff. Fairness lives in the receiver's water-filling marking, NOT in the law (weightless law), so the skeleton choice does not affect shares. Params calibrated at ref_period_ms. v_periods 2 (2026-07-22 convergence-opt campaign: MIMD's structural hard-cap immunity already covers the D7 W2 incast root-regime sync-oscillation that v_periods=4 was raised to fix under AIMD; re-verified clean at v_periods=2 with mi_alpha=0.6, incast8 Jain 0.999-1.000; halves the VQ full-scale, ~13% faster down-step convergence). MIMD-PRODUCTION PARAMS: mi_alpha=0.6 (2026-07-22, was 0.05; 12x default validated no-cliff up to convergence-time dimension too, see results/convergence_opt_20260722/summary.md), beta (MD strength, mimd-tuned 0.15, re-verified not the down-step bottleneck post MD-ceiling-floor). mi_bang: experimental MI bang-bang toggle (jump straight to e_hat instead of gradual climb), default false -- confirmed unsafe under sustained incast contention (non-deterministic severe RDMA starvation), kept only for reference, do not enable. law_skeleton selects the skeleton: mimd=production; aimd/miad retained runnable for comparison only (tx_agent switch, driven per-run by results/miad_experiment/* runners). The following are COMPARISON-ONLY, ignored when law_skeleton=mimd: aimd path a_frac_linerate/fast_recovery/hai_after/hai_max/probe_over_grant/probe_gain (its 5 refinements, obsoleted by MIMD's structural immunity) and the aimd-tuned beta=0.3 (set per-run by runners, NOT this field); miad path ad_beta/ad_mode. n1_freeze/n2_failopen (telemetry fail-open) are law-independent safety and kept. app-limited (theta_al/m_al/eps_al) is aimd-path only; MIMD's e_hat hard-cap subsumes it (inflation bounded to fair share, verified clean across the campaign).
e_params._comparison_only_aimd: params below drive law_skeleton=aimd/miad comparison runs only; MIMD production ignores them
